title: Fact and opinion sorting cards
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 89 (Fact and opinion sorting cards (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 89: Fact and opinion: how can we tell the difference?. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.title: Sort into: Fact / Opinion
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Fact, Opinion.
blocks.answer: Fact: Peas grow in pods.; Mendel was a monk.; Seeds need water to germinate.. Opinion: Peas are delicious.; Gardening is the best hobby.; Everyone loves sweet peas.

model.title: Turn into a fact: These peas grow amazingly fast.

parts.text: Fact: These peas are ready to pick about 60 days after sowing.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: These peas are ready to pick about 60 days after sowing.

keywords.def: something that can be checked and proved true
what someone thinks or feels; it cannot be proved
information that shows something is true

questions.q: Fact or opinion: Sweet peas smell lovely.
Find the opinion word: This is the finest compost.
Core: sort 12 statements and underline the opinion signals
Extend: turn three opinions into facts by adding evidence
Stretch: explain why adverts mix facts and opinions
Which is an opinion dressed as a fact?
options: Scientists agree our seeds are the most beautiful.
questions.a: B) Scientists agree our seeds are the most beautiful.. 'Most beautiful' is a judgement; adding 'scientists agree' makes it sound like a fact.
